also: when it will be convenient for you

evidence: Cic. Fam. 4.2.4: quod commodō tuō fīat (Lewis & Short s.v. commodus)
terms.comment: The ablative of commodum, convenience; so commodō meō, when it suits me.

phrases.latin: velim aliquandō, cum erit tuum commodum, Lentulum puerum vīsās
phrases.english: I’d like you to visit young Lentulus some time, when it suits you

phrases.latin: Scrībe ad mē cum commodissimē poteris.
phrases.english: Write me at your earliest convenience.
